en: The postcard features a black and white photograph of a formal statue of a woman in a long dress, possibly a queen or notable figure, atop a pedestal and surrounded by a small wrought-iron fence. The statue is set in a landscaped park or cemetery with neatly trimmed coniferous trees lining a pathway. In the background, there is a large, rocky monument or mausoleum built into a hillside, also surrounded by greenery.
